scripts.build: tsc -b && (cd ../../common && tsc-alias) && (cd ../shared && tsc-alias) && tsc-alias && yarn dist:prepare && yarn dist:copy
scripts.dist:prepare: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/common/lib dist/backend/shared/lib dist/backend/data-license/lib
scripts.dist:copy: cp -R ../../common/lib/* dist/common/lib && cp -R ../shared/lib/* dist/backend/shared/lib && cp -R ./lib/* dist/backend/data-license/lib && cp ../../yarn.lock dist && cp package.json dist
